scripts.build: mkdir -p output && cp -r src/assets output/ 2>/dev/null || true && html-minifier-terser --input-dir ./src --output-dir ./output --file-ext html --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --remove-redundant-attributes --use-short-doctype --minify-js true --minify-css true && cleancss -o output/styles.css src/styles.css && terser src/script.js --compress --mangle -o output/script.js && terser src/features.js --compress --mangle -o output/features.js && (cp src/favicon.ico output/ 2>/dev/null || true)
